logic.description: Class permanent (5 colours, 6-tokens, indestructible). static, implemented in peer.mjs: once the holder has dealt combat damage this round (dealt_damage_this_round), every later Attack that lands (matrix damage >= 1) deals +1 extra damage. prerequisites.description: The class card sits in the caster's permanents.
The holder has already dealt combat damage this round and is Attacking.

effects.description: Every colour token of the class card has fixed value 6.
One token per listed colour.
+1 when the Attack lands and the holder already connected this round, else 0.
Rule 24 never destroys the class card.

validation.description: Colour count stays within +-1 of canonical.
The damage rider stays a static ability.

notes: Class cards enter as permanents with tokens of value 6 per color. Destroy cost = point-buy ALL listed colors (count-per-color irrelevant) against value 6. ability_kind ∈ { once_per_round | static | tap }. Untap by emitting each listed color once.
